facade_room_cast.name: The Room and Its Volume
facade_room_cast.description: A doorway and window drawn from the existing facade vocabulary lead into a room. Beside it, the shared void is intersected with the same stock to make a positive counterpart, retaining the opening profiles and wall-rail impression.
interactions: Enter the room, follow its curved alcove, and return through the door.
Look through the window, then find its corresponding projection on the positive.
Walk around the positive; its apparent doorway is solid.
facade_room_cast.qfep_connection: A shared boundary receives a body in one construction and excludes it in the corresponding positive. Architectural details make the change recognisable; Whiteread offers a reference for negative space, traces and loss, without treating a digital operation as physical casting.
facade_room_cast.validation: Isolated desktop mesh-partition and capsule checks; tracked-headset and full museum-loader verification remain separate.
